description: This file is a FastAPI application implementing REST endpoints for health checks and CRUD operations on 'templates', backed by SQLAlchemy ORM and SQLite database. It includes app configuration, database initialization, dependency management, and route definitions for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting template records.
